children: Multicoin Capital founder and CIO Tushar Jain said current crypto market sentiment appears somewhat overheated and that a pullback or period of consolidation cannot be ruled out. According to ChainCatcher, he advised investors to stay calm, avoid overtrading, and focus on holding high-quality assets rather than trying to time every short-term high and low.

title: Multicoin Capital's Tushar Jain Warns Crypto Market May Face Pullback
